Name: Lance sends schedule in the mail
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[size=3][b]Introduction[/b][/size]
Lance from Stardew Valley Expanded gives you his schedule when you meet, as an item. This mod makes him send his schedule one day later by mail, so you can always find it in your collection tab. More convenient than finding the chest where you left his schedule, because you can access mail anywhere.

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Can be installed any time, if you have received his schedule already you will receive the mail the next day.

[size=3][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]
I don't think there is anything to add or improve. Suggestions are welcome.
